# Camera runtime dependencies

Vendored unchanged from their versioned upstream packages to remove runtime CDN dependencies.

- Three.js 0.186.0: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.186.0/ ; MIT license in three/LICENSE.
- MediaPipe Tasks Vision 1.0.1: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@mediapipe/tasks-vision@1.0.1/ ; Apache-2.0, upstream copyright/license headers retained.
- MediaPipe hand, face, and pose landmark models (float16 version 1): https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/ ; upstream MediaPipe models.
- PeerJS 1.5.4: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/peerjs/1.5.4/peerjs.min.js ; MIT license, upstream header retained.
